purpose: Synthetic declarative packages for the 1,000-contribution/20-extension resolution gate and the 100-cycle lifetime gate. Generated deterministically by tests/extensions-performance.spec.ts and src-tauri/src/extensions/packages.rs; nothing here executes.

budgets.heapPolicy: Chromium JS heap after forced GC, sampled every 10 cycles: the last sample stays within heapSettleMiB of the warmed cycle-10 sample, and a heap-snapshot census between cycles 20 and 100 finds no JS object/closure/string class or DOM node class retained once per cycle. Engine caches (JIT code, style data, bounded performance-timeline buffers) are reported, not attributed. WebKit exposes no heap metric; its registration counts still gate.

noise.definition: A population is incomparable when (p95 - median) / median exceeds maxDispersion, when the machine was busier than maxMachineBusyPercent in the idle three seconds before sampling, or when the build differs from the frozen vite-production population. Incomparable relative results are reported, never counted as a pass.
